changelog:
auto-exposure-limitation v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill to explain the limitations of auto/program exposure modes in cameras.
- Helps users understand why auto mode photos look similar and how program mode prioritizes technical safety over creative choices.
- Provides guidance on transitioning from auto to aperture priority, shutter priority, or manual modes for greater creative control.
- Includes practical tips on "tricking" semi-automatic modes for indirect control over exposure.
- Clearly distinguishes this skill from those for specific exposure parameter choices or light metering issues.
